# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.0 Worker 4: Cross-Civilization Global Synthesis (oe_syn_, 0 mainline slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v130_synthesis.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Cross-Civilization Global Synthesis Scripted Effects & Dev Page 89 Helpers (CMDLOG = 0).

# Any country scope. Explicitly initialize own counters before any change_variable / change_global_variable.
oe_syn_ensure_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_syn_global_syntheses_completed } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_syn_global_syntheses_completed value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_syn_country_syntheses } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_syn_country_syntheses value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Increment synthesis counters safely (always initialized first).
oe_syn_record_synthesis_done = {
	oe_syn_ensure_init = yes
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_syn_global_syntheses_completed add = 1 }
	change_variable = { name = oe_syn_country_syntheses add = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Safely push a spawned institution in capital (if capital exists and has not embraced it yet).
oe_syn_push_capital_inst = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			institution:$inst$ = { has_spawned = yes }
			capital = { NOT = { has_institution = institution:$inst$ } }
		}
		capital = {
			change_institution_progress = { type = institution:$inst$ value = $val$ }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. O(1) yearly synthesis event dispatcher (fires at most 1 event per country per year).
oe_syn_yearly_dispatch = {
	oe_syn_ensure_init = yes
	if = {
		limit = { oe_syn_ev8_eligible = yes }
		set_variable = { name = oe_syn_ev8_seen value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_syn.8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_syn_ev1_eligible = yes }
		set_variable = { name = oe_syn_ev1_seen value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_syn.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_syn_ev2_eligible = yes }
		set_variable = { name = oe_syn_ev2_seen value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_syn.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_syn_ev3_eligible = yes }
		set_variable = { name = oe_syn_ev3_seen value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_syn.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_syn_ev4_eligible = yes }
		set_variable = { name = oe_syn_ev4_seen value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_syn.4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_syn_ev5_eligible = yes }
		set_variable = { name = oe_syn_ev5_seen value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_syn.5

	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_syn_ev6_eligible = yes }

	else_if = {

	}
}

# Decision 1 effect: Convene Trans-Continental Manuscript & Meridian Exchange
oe_syn_enact_meridian_congress = {
	oe_syn_record_synthesis_done = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_syn_dec_meridian_done value = 1 }
	add_gold = -150
	add_research_progress = research_progress_mild_bonus
	add_prestige = 10
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_syn_meridian_exchange_mod
		years = 25
		mode = replace
	}
	oe_syn_push_capital_inst = { inst = printing_press val = 20 }
	oe_syn_push_capital_inst = { inst = enlightenment val = 20 }
}

# Decision 2 effect: Proclaim the Republic of All Nations Charter
oe_syn_enact_republic_of_all_nations = {
	add_gold = -200
	set_variable = { name = oe_syn_ev8_seen value = 1 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_syn.8
}
